purpose: Deploy and maintain Convoy using this repository's reviewed shell scripts.
notes: Read installconvoy.sh before installation and build_swap.sh before changing swap. Uninstallation changes services and data; inspect uninstallconvoy.sh and preserve required backups.
purpose_zh: 按仓库现有脚本部署和维护 Convoy 面板。
notes_zh: 安装前阅读 installconvoy.sh，更改 swap 前阅读 build_swap.sh。卸载会影响服务及数据，应核对 uninstallconvoy.sh 并保留所需备份。
